headline: The Spruce Goose flies for the only time
post_facts: A 320-foot wingspan, built mostly of birch
About 70 feet up, for about a mile

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen forty-seven... Howard Hughes flew a giant wooden flying boat.

scenes.label: H-4 Hercules
scenes.caption: The giant flying boat on the water
scenes.title: Built mostly of birch, not spruce
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] The H-4 Hercules, nicknamed the Spruce Goose, was built mostly of birch.

scenes.label: from wingtip to wingtip
scenes.text: [calmly] Its wings stretched three hundred twenty feet.

scenes.label: Howard Hughes
scenes.caption: Hughes was at the controls himself
scenes.title: About 70 feet up, for about a mile
scenes.text: [softly] Over Long Beach harbor, it rose about seventy feet... and flew about a mile.

scenes.title: It never flew again
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] It never flew again. Today it rests in an Oregon museum.
